follow-up time: Time to subsequent ongoing pregnancy or pregnancy leading to a live birth
exposure: management strategy (expectant management, methotrexate, curettage with temporary cervical cerclage, laparoscopic niche resection)
outcome: time to subsequent ongoing pregnancy or pregnancy leading to a live birth
cohort: Women with a cesarean scar pregnancy
finding: Surgical treatment of cesarean scar pregnancy resulted in a high success rate, high pregnancy rates, and a short time interval to subsequent pregnancy compared to conservative management.
